title: The Air Ambulance Service granted planning permission for new airbase in Leicestershire
summary: A new airbase is urgently required due to the permanent closure of Coventry Airport earlier this year, TAAS said.
body_markdown:
The Air Ambulance Service (TAAS) has been granted permission for a new operational helicopter airbase to serve Warwickshire, Northamptonshire, and Leicestershire.


A new airbase for TAAS is urgently required due to the permanent closure of Coventry Airport earlier this year.


After an extensive search the charity identified a six-acre agricultural site to the north of Catthorpe, Leicestershire strategically chosen for rapid access to major motorways and with equitable flying distances for the three counties.


At a meeting on November 17, the Planning Committee of Harborough District Council approved the plans for the new base, meaning that construction work can begin as soon as possible.


Once completed, the base will enable rapid deployment of both helicopters and Critical Care Cars, reducing response times to incidents — a vital factor in saving lives.


As well as the helicopter emergency medical service (operated by TAAS under the name “Your Local Air Ambulance”) the base will also be a launching site for missions for the National Children’s Air Ambulance, the U.K.’s only helicopter transfer service for seriously ill children and babies.


TAAS chief executive Peta Wilkinson said: “This is a monumental moment for our charity. The closure of Coventry Airport made the need to find a new permanent home an urgent need not just for us, but for the people we fly to rescue every day of the year.”


“We are immensely grateful to the people who have helped us to secure the planning permission — especially the people in and around Catthorpe who helped us to develop our plans throughout the consultation phase and expressed such support for our life-saving mission.


“Creating the new air base is our biggest ever project, and we have launched an appeal to raise the money needed to build this new facility for the communities we help, and to ensure we are there whenever and wherever they need us.”


For more information, visit[bigbases.uk/planning-news](https://bigbases.uk/planning-news)


*This press release was prepared and distributed by The Air Ambulance Service.*
